discrepancies.explanation: In the primary batch run, applications 1 through 64 were executed sequentially until Groq's Tokens Per Day (TPD: 200,000) rate limit was reached at app 64. 60 applications completed and were written to output/research_dataset.json. Three additional applications (ID 71 Notion, ID 81 Stripe, ID 91 NotebookLM) exist as genuine, validated research records in output/research_results/ from the 10-app pilot run. Total researched across all output files is 63 unique applications.
